_comment: Independent B24 equipment-reassessment witness: the source-selected untamed pickup reaches the out-of-sight equipment boundary after sixteen searches, and the seventeenth search runs the production worn.c m_dowear turn. The first segment ends immediately after the cloak is worn; the second continues one more search as a cheap longer-turn variation. Its final frames have no pickup or wear text, so the recording is not counted as visible proof from screen text; the production runSegment state check records goblin PM_GOBLIN carrying CLOAK_OF_PROTECTION before the turn and W_ARMC after it. The seed, clock, character, and searches were selected independently of the fixed holdout.
